dos: Do let emerald own every action and gold own every brand moment (The Two Lights Rule).
Do keep Amiri to the logo and card titles; everything else is Cairo.
Do give keyboard focus the gold ring on every interactive element.
Do pair every color-coded state with text or an icon, never color alone.
Do keep body text at 4.5:1 or better — verify computed pairs, not intent.
donts: Don't bring back stark gold-on-black coldness or generic SaaS blue.
Don't use gradient text; emphasis comes from weight or size.
Don't spend the primary emerald on decoration or the gold on buttons.
Don't add a third typeface, a modal, or a nested card to solve a layout.
Don't ship a new screen that the live panel cannot render from these tokens — extend the system instead.
keyCharacteristics: Warm emerald action + honey gold brand light on a deep green night
Frosted glass cards with ambient glow, never flat panels
Amiri display serif over Cairo body — Quranic voice, everyday readability
Generous radii (16–32px); pills reserved for small round controls
narrative.overview: Warm first light over green: a calm, welcoming tool that feels alive rather than luxurious-cold. The interface is a single-page daily ritual — one form, one progress card, one player — so the world stays quiet and lets the two accents speak: emerald acts, gold glows. Glass surfaces float over a deep green night with ambient light borrowed from both accents; nothing is sharp, nothing shouts, and the primary action is always the easiest thing to find. The old stark gold-on-black coldness is retired and must never return.

rules.body: Emerald moves things forward; gold marks what matters. No element wears both jobs, and neither appears where it has no role.
rules.name: The Two Lights Rule

rules.body: Amiri names things; Cairo explains them. No third typeface, no display face outside the header and card titles.
rules.name: The Two Voices Rule

rules.body: Every glow traces to emerald action or gold brand light; decorative halos with no role are removed, not toned down.
rules.name: The Light Means Something Rule
